verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents per-user notification rules: On-Call Readiness Reports check responders' notification rule configurations, and the REST API configures how each user is notified. Hands-on community reports confirm app push notifications that escalate to a phone call when not acknowledged, but the evidence never explicitly names SMS or email as page channels or details per-channel rule options. missing for 10: explicit documentation of SMS and email notification channels, detail on per-channel rule configuration (delays, ordering, urgency), first-party docs describing push and phone call delivery.
